meta.source: 手工整理（四六级考纲常用搭配/形容词辨析/句式）+ 本地 35 套真题频次实测

groups.title: account for
groups.tip: 不是「算账」；与 count on（依靠）区分
groups.example: Women account for nearly half of the workforce.
groups.exampleZh: 女性占劳动力的近一半。

groups.title: result in
groups.tip: result in 后接结果；result from 后接原因
groups.example: The policy resulted in a sharp rise in prices.
groups.exampleZh: 该政策导致物价大幅上涨。

groups.title: result from
groups.tip: 与 result in 方向相反
groups.example: The delay resulted from heavy traffic.
groups.exampleZh: 延误是由严重堵车造成的。

groups.title: consist of
groups.tip: 不用被动；consist in 是「在于」
groups.example: The committee consists of ten members.
groups.exampleZh: 委员会由十名成员组成。

groups.title: be composed of
groups.tip: 必须带 be，composed 是过去分词
groups.example: The team is composed of experts from five countries.
groups.exampleZh: 该团队由五国专家构成。

groups.title: give rise to
groups.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词
groups.example: The discovery gave rise to a new field of study.
groups.exampleZh: 这一发现催生了一个新研究领域。

groups.title: contribute to
groups.tip: to 是介词，不接动词原形
groups.example: Exercise contributes to better sleep.

groups.title: lead to
groups.tip: lead to 后接结果，不接人
groups.example: Careless driving leads to accidents.

groups.title: be subject to
groups.tip: to 是介词；subject 是形容词
groups.example: Prices are subject to change without notice.
groups.exampleZh: 价格如有变动恕不另行通知。

groups.title: be exposed to
groups.example: Children are exposed to too much screen time.
groups.exampleZh: 孩子接触屏幕的时间太多。

groups.title: be immune to
groups.tip: to 是介词；immunity 是名词
groups.example: No industry is immune to the downturn.
groups.exampleZh: 没有行业能免受衰退影响。

groups.title: be liable to
groups.tip: liable to do；be liable for 是「对…负责」
groups.example: Such plans are liable to fail.

groups.title: be capable of
groups.example: She is capable of handling the project alone.
groups.exampleZh: 她有能力独自处理这个项目。

groups.title: be aware of
groups.tip: aware 后不接 that 以外的从句时用 of
groups.example: Few people are aware of the risk.
groups.exampleZh: 很少有人意识到这个风险。

groups.title: be short of
groups.tip: short of 是「缺少」，不是「矮」
groups.example: The hospital is short of nurses.

groups.title: in terms of
groups.example: In terms of cost, this option is better.
groups.exampleZh: 就成本而言，这个方案更好。

groups.title: in favor of
groups.example: Most students are in favor of the change.
groups.exampleZh: 多数学生支持这项改变。

groups.title: in charge of
groups.tip: in the charge of 是「由…负责」
groups.example: She is in charge of the marketing team.

groups.title: in response to
groups.example: The company cut prices in response to competition.
groups.exampleZh: 公司为回应竞争而降价。

groups.title: in contrast to
groups.tip: to 是介词；by contrast 单独用
groups.example: In contrast to last year, sales doubled.

groups.title: on behalf of
groups.example: I am writing on behalf of the student union.

groups.title: at the expense of
groups.example: Growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
groups.exampleZh: 增长不应以环境为代价。

groups.title: take ... into account
groups.example: We must take cost into account.
groups.exampleZh: 我们必须把成本考虑在内。

groups.title: take advantage of
groups.example: Students should take advantage of the library.

groups.title: make use of
groups.example: We made good use of the free time.
groups.exampleZh: 我们很好地利用了空闲时间。

groups.title: pay attention to
groups.example: Pay attention to the details.

groups.title: attach importance to
groups.example: The government attaches great importance to education.

groups.title: play a role in
groups.example: Parents play a key role in a child's growth.
groups.exampleZh: 父母在孩子成长中起关键作用。

groups.title: make a difference
groups.example: Small habits can make a big difference.

groups.title: have access to
groups.example: Rural students now have access to online courses.
groups.exampleZh: 农村学生现在能上在线课程。

groups.title: be attributed to
groups.tip: 与 contribute to 方向相反
groups.example: The success is attributed to teamwork.

groups.title: be committed to
groups.example: The firm is committed to reducing waste.
groups.exampleZh: 该公司致力于减少浪费。

groups.title: be devoted to
groups.example: He is devoted to teaching.

groups.title: be engaged in
groups.tip: be engaged to sb 是「与某人订婚」
groups.example: She is engaged in cancer research.

groups.title: be involved in
groups.example: Many firms are involved in the project.

groups.title: be responsible for
groups.example: Drivers are responsible for their passengers' safety.

groups.title: be dependent on
groups.tip: dependent 是形容词，depend 是动词
groups.example: The town is dependent on tourism.

groups.title: be consistent with
groups.example: The results are consistent with earlier studies.

groups.title: be relevant to
groups.example: The question is not relevant to our topic.
groups.exampleZh: 这个问题与我们的主题无关。

groups.title: be beneficial to
groups.tip: to 是介词；也可用 for
groups.example: Regular exercise is beneficial to health.

groups.title: be essential to
groups.example: Water is essential to life.

groups.title: be similar to
groups.example: Her view is similar to mine.

groups.title: be familiar with
groups.tip: be familiar to sb 是「为某人所熟悉」
groups.example: I am familiar with this software.

groups.title: be curious about
groups.example: Children are curious about everything.

groups.title: be anxious about
groups.tip: be anxious to do 是「渴望做」
groups.example: She is anxious about the exam.

groups.title: be keen on
groups.example: He is keen on outdoor sports.

groups.title: be fond of
groups.tip: of 后接名词或动名词
groups.example: She is fond of classical music.

groups.title: be accustomed to
groups.tip: to 是介词，后接动名词
groups.example: They are accustomed to cold weather.

groups.title: be opposed to
groups.example: Many residents are opposed to the plan.

groups.title: be inclined to
groups.example: I am inclined to agree with you.

groups.title: be bound to
groups.tip: 与 be bound for（开往）区分
groups.example: Such mistakes are bound to happen.

groups.title: be supposed to
groups.example: You are supposed to submit it by Friday.

groups.title: be willing to
groups.example: She is willing to help.

groups.title: be likely to
groups.example: Prices are likely to rise.

groups.title: be able to
groups.tip: 比 can 多用于完成时与将来时
groups.example: He was able to finish it alone.

groups.title: be about to
groups.example: The train is about to leave.

groups.title: be used to
groups.tip: used to do 是「过去常常」；be used to doing 是「习惯」
groups.example: I am used to getting up early.

groups.title: used to
groups.tip: 与 be used to 完全不同
groups.example: He used to smoke.

groups.title: be made of
groups.example: The table is made of wood.

groups.title: be made from
groups.example: Paper is made from wood.

groups.title: turn out
groups.example: The plan turned out well.

groups.title: carry out
groups.example: They carried out a survey.

groups.title: bring about
groups.example: Technology has brought about huge changes.

groups.title: break down
groups.example: The car broke down on the way.

groups.title: come up with
groups.example: She came up with a clever solution.
groups.exampleZh: 她想出一个巧妙的方案。

groups.title: put up with
groups.example: I can't put up with the noise.

groups.title: look forward to
groups.tip: to 是介词，后接动名词
groups.example: I look forward to hearing from you.

groups.title: look into
groups.example: Police are looking into the case.

groups.title: look up to
groups.tip: 与 look down on（轻视）相对
groups.example: Students look up to their teachers.

groups.title: get rid of
groups.example: We must get rid of the bad habit.
groups.exampleZh: 我们必须摆脱这个坏习惯。

groups.title: make up for
groups.example: Nothing can make up for the loss.
groups.exampleZh: 什么也无法弥补这个损失。

groups.title: keep up with
groups.example: It is hard to keep up with technology.

groups.title: catch up with
groups.tip: 与 keep up with 区分
groups.example: He worked hard to catch up with others.

groups.title: run out of
groups.tip: run out 不及物；run out of 及物
groups.example: We ran out of time.

groups.title: figure out
groups.example: I can't figure out the answer.

groups.title: point out
groups.example: He pointed out a serious mistake.

groups.title: set up
groups.example: They set up a new company.
groups.exampleZh: 他们成立了一家新公司。

groups.title: take on
groups.example: She took on more responsibility.

groups.title: take over
groups.tip: 与 take up（开始从事）区分
groups.example: A rival took over the firm.
groups.exampleZh: 竞争对手接管了这家公司。

groups.title: take up
groups.example: He took up painting last year.

groups.title: work out
groups.example: Things worked out in the end.

groups.title: give in
groups.example: He refused to give in.

groups.title: give up
groups.example: Never give up your dream.

groups.title: hold on
groups.example: Hold on, I'll check it.

groups.title: go through
groups.example: She went through a hard time.
groups.exampleZh: 她经历了一段艰难时期。

groups.title: deal with
groups.example: We must deal with the problem now.
groups.exampleZh: 我们必须现在处理问题。

groups.title: cope with
groups.example: Some families cannot cope with the pressure.
groups.exampleZh: 一些家庭无法应对压力。

groups.title: refer to
groups.example: He referred to the report twice.

groups.title: rely on
groups.example: We rely on renewable energy.

groups.title: focus on
groups.example: Focus on the main idea.

groups.title: depend on
groups.example: It depends on the weather.

groups.title: insist on
groups.example: She insisted on paying.

groups.title: object to
groups.example: They objected to the new rule.

groups.title: approve of
groups.example: Her parents approved of the plan.

groups.title: complain about
groups.tip: complain of 多指「诉说病痛」
groups.example: He complained about the noise.

groups.title: apologize for
groups.example: She apologized for being late.

groups.title: blame ... for
groups.tip: blame sth on sb 也可
groups.example: Don't blame others for your mistakes.

groups.title: congratulate ... on
groups.example: We congratulated her on the award.

groups.title: prevent ... from
groups.example: Rain prevented us from going out.

groups.title: protect ... from
groups.example: Sunscreen protects skin from damage.
groups.exampleZh: 防晒霜保护皮肤免受损伤。

groups.title: substitute A for B
groups.tip: 方向易错：for 后是被代替的
groups.example: You can substitute honey for sugar.

groups.title: replace A with B
groups.example: They replaced coal with gas.

groups.title: economic / economical
groups.tip: economic growth 经济增长 / an economical car 省油的车

groups.title: historic / historical
groups.zh: historic=有历史意义的，historical=与历史有关的
groups.tip: a historic moment 历史性时刻 / historical documents 历史文献

groups.title: sensible / sensitive
groups.tip: a sensible decision 明智的决定 / sensitive skin 敏感肌

groups.title: considerable / considerate
groups.tip: considerable damage 相当大的损失 / a considerate friend 体贴的朋友

groups.title: respectful / respectable / respective
groups.tip: respectful attitude 恭敬的态度 / a respectable job 体面的工作 / their respective roles 各自的角色

groups.title: industrial / industrious
groups.tip: industrial waste 工业废料 / an industrious student 勤奋的学生

groups.title: comprehensive / comprehensible
groups.tip: a comprehensive survey 全面调查 / comprehensible input 可理解输入

groups.title: imaginary / imaginative / imaginable
groups.zh: imaginary=虚构的，imaginative=有想象力的，imaginable=可想象的
groups.tip: an imaginary friend 虚构的朋友 / imaginative writing 富有想象力的写作

groups.title: continual / continuous
groups.zh: continual=反复发生（有间断），continuous=连续不断
groups.tip: continual interruptions 反复打扰 / continuous rain 连绵不断的雨

groups.title: principal / principle
groups.tip: the principal reason 主要原因 / a moral principle 道德原则

groups.title: adaptable / adaptive
groups.zh: adaptable=适应力强的（人/物），adaptive=适应性的（系统/机制）
groups.tip: an adaptable child 适应力强的孩子 / adaptive learning 自适应学习

groups.title: efficient / effective
groups.zh: efficient=效率高的（省时省力），effective=有效的（达成目的）
groups.tip: an efficient system 高效系统 / an effective method 有效方法

groups.title: valueless / invaluable / priceless
groups.tip: valueless advice 无用的建议 / invaluable experience 宝贵经验

groups.title: ashamed / shameful
groups.tip: be ashamed of 为…羞愧 / shameful behavior 可耻行为

groups.title: bored / boring
groups.zh: -ed 修饰人（感到…），-ing 修饰事物（令人…）
groups.tip: I am bored. 我感到无聊 / a boring lecture 无聊的讲座

groups.title: interested / interesting
groups.tip: interested students 感兴趣的学生 / an interesting book 有趣的书

groups.title: excited / exciting
groups.tip: excited children 兴奋的孩子 / exciting news 振奋的消息

groups.title: tired / tiring
groups.tip: a tired worker 疲惫的工人 / a tiring journey 累人的旅程

groups.title: satisfied / satisfying
groups.tip: a satisfied customer 满意的顾客 / a satisfying result 令人满意的结果

groups.title: confused / confusing
groups.tip: confused students 困惑的学生 / confusing instructions 令人困惑的说明

groups.title: disappointed / disappointing
groups.tip: a disappointed fan 失望的粉丝 / disappointing results 令人失望的结果

groups.title: alive / living / live
groups.zh: alive=活着的（表语），living=活着的（定语），live=现场的/活的（动物）
groups.tip: keep hope alive 保持希望 / living things 生物 / a live broadcast 直播

groups.title: alone / lonely
groups.zh: alone=独自（客观），lonely=孤独（主观感受）
groups.tip: live alone 独居 / feel lonely 感到孤独

groups.title: worth / worthy / worthwhile
groups.zh: worth+doing，worthy of+名词，worthwhile to do/it is worthwhile doing
groups.tip: worth trying 值得一试 / worthy of praise 值得表扬 / a worthwhile cause 有价值的事业

groups.title: possible / probable / likely
groups.zh: 可能性依次增强；likely 主语可为人
groups.tip: a possible cause 可能原因 / a probable outcome 很可能的结果 / likely to win 可能获胜

groups.title: essential / necessary / vital
groups.zh: essential=必不可少（绝对），necessary=必要，vital=至关重要
groups.tip: essential nutrients 必需营养 / necessary steps 必要步骤 / a vital role 关键作用

groups.title: rare / scarce
groups.zh: rare=稀有（不常见），scarce=短缺（供不应求）
groups.tip: a rare species 稀有物种 / scarce resources 稀缺资源

groups.title: hollow / empty / vacant
groups.zh: hollow=中空的，empty=空的（无内容），vacant=空缺的（职位/房间）
groups.tip: a hollow tree 空心树 / an empty box 空盒子 / a vacant post 空缺职位

groups.title: bare / empty
groups.tip: bare feet 光脚 / an empty room 空房间

groups.title: sensible / sensual
groups.tip: a sensible choice 明智选择 / sensual pleasure 感官愉悦

groups.title: credible / credulous / creditable
groups.tip: a credible witness 可信的证人 / a credulous buyer 轻信的买家 / creditable results 值得称赞的成绩

groups.title: intense / intensive
groups.zh: intense=强烈的（感受/程度），intensive=密集的（强度/集约）
groups.tip: intense heat 酷热 / intensive training 密集训练

groups.title: eligible / illegible
groups.zh: eligible=合格的/有资格的，illegible=字迹难辨的
groups.tip: eligible for the post 有资格担任 / illegible handwriting 难以辨认的字

groups.title: moral / morale
groups.tip: moral standards 道德标准 / boost morale 提振士气

groups.title: childish / childlike
groups.tip: childish behavior 幼稚行为 / a childlike smile 天真的微笑

groups.title: economical / frugal / thrifty
groups.zh: economical=省钱的，frugal=节俭的（生活），thrifty=精打细算的
groups.tip: an economical car 省油的车 / a frugal meal 简朴的一餐 / thrifty habits 节俭习惯

groups.title: confident / confidential
groups.tip: a confident speaker 自信的讲者 / confidential files 机密文件

groups.title: complementary / complimentary
groups.tip: complementary skills 互补技能 / a complimentary ticket 赠票

groups.title: stationary / stationery
groups.tip: a stationary car 停着的车 / office stationery 办公文具

groups.title: personal / personnel
groups.tip: personal data 个人数据 / sales personnel 销售人员

groups.title: successive / successful
groups.tip: three successive years 连续三年 / a successful attempt 成功的尝试

groups.title: former / previous / prior
groups.zh: former=前任的/前者，previous=以前的，prior=先前的/优先的
groups.tip: the former president 前总统 / the previous chapter 前一章 / prior experience 先前经验

groups.title: later / latter / latest / last
groups.zh: later=后来，latter=后者，latest=最新的，last=最后的
groups.tip: two years later 两年后 / the latter option 后者 / the latest news 最新消息

groups.title: abundant / plentiful
groups.zh: abundant=丰富的（正式），plentiful=充足的（数量）
groups.tip: abundant resources 丰富资源 / a plentiful supply 充足供应

groups.title: urgent / emergent
groups.tip: an urgent task 紧急任务 / emergent technology 新兴技术

groups.title: alternate / alternative
groups.zh: alternate=交替的/轮流的，alternative=替代的/另一种
groups.tip: alternate days 隔天 / an alternative plan 备选方案

groups.title: distinct / distinctive / distinguished
groups.zh: distinct=明显的/不同的，distinctive=有特色的，distinguished=卓越的
groups.tip: a distinct sound 清晰的声音 / a distinctive style 独特风格 / a distinguished scholar 杰出学者

groups.title: tolerant / tolerable
groups.tip: a tolerant attitude 宽容态度 / tolerable pain 可忍受的疼痛

groups.title: desirable / desired
groups.zh: desirable=值得拥有的（客观好），desired=想要的（主观）
groups.tip: a desirable location 理想地段 / the desired effect 预期效果

groups.title: negligible / negligent
groups.tip: negligible cost 微不足道的成本 / negligent driving 疏忽驾驶

groups.title: practical / practicable
groups.tip: practical skills 实用技能 / a practicable plan 可行的计划

groups.title: beneficial / beneficent
groups.tip: beneficial effects 有益效果 / a beneficent donor 慈善捐赠者

groups.title: credulous / gullible
groups.zh: credulous=轻信的（偏书面），gullible=易受骗的（口语）
groups.tip: credulous readers 轻信的读者 / a gullible child 易受骗的孩子

groups.title: Not only ... but also ...
groups.tip: Not only 置句首要部分倒装
groups.example: Not only does exercise improve health, but it also reduces stress.
groups.exampleZh: 运动不仅改善健康，还能减压。

groups.title: It is ... that ...（强调句）
groups.tip: 去掉 It is/that 句子仍完整
groups.example: It is education that changes lives.

groups.title: It is widely believed that ...
groups.tip: 形式主语，that 从句是真主语
groups.example: It is widely believed that reading broadens the mind.
groups.exampleZh: 人们普遍认为阅读开阔心智。

groups.title: There is a growing awareness that ...
groups.example: There is a growing awareness that mental health matters.
groups.exampleZh: 人们越来越意识到心理健康很重要。

groups.title: With the development of ...
groups.example: With the development of technology, our lives have changed.
groups.exampleZh: 随着技术发展，我们的生活改变了。

groups.title: As far as I am concerned, ...
groups.example: As far as I am concerned, the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.

groups.title: From my perspective, ...
groups.tip: 比 in my opinion 更书面
groups.example: From my perspective, the policy is reasonable.
groups.exampleZh: 在我看来，该政策是合理的。

groups.title: The more ..., the more ...
groups.example: The more you practice, the more confident you become.

groups.title: It is high time that ... did
groups.example: It is high time that we took action.

groups.title: Only by ... can we ...
groups.example: Only by working together can we solve it.

groups.title: so ... that ...
groups.example: The problem is so complex that few can solve it.
groups.exampleZh: 问题如此复杂，少有人能解决。

groups.title: such ... that ...
groups.example: It was such a cold day that we stayed in.

groups.title: too ... to ...
groups.example: He is too young to understand.

groups.title: not ... until ...
groups.example: He did not leave until midnight.

groups.title: hardly ... when ...
groups.example: Hardly had he arrived when it rained.

groups.title: no sooner ... than ...
groups.example: No sooner had she left than the phone rang.

groups.title: It goes without saying that ...
groups.example: It goes without saying that health comes first.

groups.title: There is no denying that ...
groups.example: There is no denying that AI changes work.
groups.exampleZh: 不可否认 AI 改变工作。

groups.title: When it comes to ..., ...
groups.example: When it comes to cost, this option wins.
groups.exampleZh: 谈到成本，这个方案更好。

groups.title: In spite of / Despite ..., ...
groups.example: Despite the rain, they went out.

groups.title: Even if / Even though ..., ...
groups.tip: even if 假设，even though 事实
groups.example: Even if it rains, we will go.

groups.title: As long as ..., ...
groups.example: As long as you try, you will improve.

groups.title: Unless ..., ...
groups.example: Unless you hurry, you will be late.

groups.title: The reason why ... is that ...
groups.tip: 不能用 because 引导表语
groups.example: The reason why he failed is that he was careless.

groups.title: What matters most is ...
groups.example: What matters most is your attitude.

groups.title: It is no use doing ...
groups.example: It is no use crying over spilt milk.

groups.title: There is no point in doing ...
groups.example: There is no point in arguing.

groups.title: be worth doing
groups.example: The film is worth watching.

groups.title: have difficulty (in) doing
groups.example: Many students have difficulty in writing.

groups.title: spend ... doing
groups.example: She spends hours reading.

groups.title: prefer A to B
groups.zh: 宁愿 A 不愿 B
groups.example: I prefer tea to coffee.

groups.title: would rather ... than ...
groups.example: I would rather walk than wait.

groups.title: not only because ... but also because ...
groups.example: He succeeded not only because he was smart but also because he worked hard.
groups.exampleZh: 他成功不仅因为聪明，也因为努力。

groups.title: It is said/reported that ...
groups.example: It is reported that prices will rise.

groups.title: There used to be ...
groups.example: There used to be a park here.

groups.title: No matter how/what/who ..., ...
groups.example: No matter how hard it is, don't give up.

groups.title: Given that ..., ...
groups.example: Given that time is limited, we must prioritize.
groups.exampleZh: 考虑到时间有限，我们必须分清主次。

groups.title: Compared with/to ..., ...
groups.example: Compared with last year, sales rose.

groups.title: Faced with ..., ...
groups.example: Faced with difficulties, she stayed calm.

groups.title: Only when ... did ...
groups.example: Only when we lost it did we value it.
